messages:
emma_prod: Dropped a compact mock for the Usage & Billing landing — https://www.figma.com/file/def/usage-billing-compact (please check 'Landing - Compact' frame). Main callout: do we force org-first or let power users land on project grid?

liam_design: I prototyped a persistent scope toggle (Org / Projects) top-left. It remembers state per-user and is URL-shareable. Keeps both groups happy.

sam_sre: That works but we should server-trust the default. Backend can return user.recommended_scope so clients don't guess. Also adding a feature flag for rollout is sensible.

nora_fin: Billing note: invoices are org-scoped. If we show projects first, make sure invoice CTAs clarify "Org invoice" and are disabled for non-billing roles.

liam_design: noted. For project cards I propose: Est. charges (pre-tax), token count, and a small 'Invoice' link that routes to org invoice with context. Expandable card shows a condensed token breakdown.

hannah_a11y: accessibility items: 1) scope toggle must be a real button with aria-pressed and an accessible label. 2) expanded card should trap focus and be dismissible by Esc. 3) sparklines must have associated SR-only data tables. Also contrast for the status pill needs to meet 4.5:1.

emma_prod: actionable: Liam update the toggle to be a semantic button and adjust pill contrast; Sam add recommended_scope API and feature flag; Nora confirm invoice copy and RBAC. Hannah will run a quick a11y check after updates.

liam_design: quick UX question: token breakdown — show inline micro-breakdown (tokens | compute | discounts) or an accordion to avoid clutter?

sam_sre: prefer accordion with lazy-load for details. Return summary in the initial payload to avoid churn.

emma_prod: agree. Also add a tiny switch in the accordion header to toggle percentage vs absolute tokens (request from support).

hannah_a11y: ensure the toggle has an aria-checked state and updates accessible text like "Showing token breakdown as percentages".

nora_fin: copy tweak: use 'Estimated charges (pre-tax)' instead of just 'Est charges'. Legal prefers explicitness.

deploy-bot: Reminder: design-review booked Friday 14:00 UTC. :calendar:

emma_prod: Thanks all. Liam will post updated figma link when done; Sam will PR API changes next week. Closing unless blockers appear.
